description: Source code for Android BinderDebug utility functions, including context conversion, binder context scanning, and parsing binder logs to extract information about binder nodes, threads, and client PIDs.

methods.name: contextToString
methods.description: Converts a BinderDebugContext enum to its string representation.

methods.name: scanBinderContext
methods.description: Reads binder logs for a given process ID and context, applying a callback to each relevant line.

methods.name: getBinderPidInfo
methods.description: Extracts binder node and thread information for a process, populating a BinderPidInfo structure.

methods.name: getBinderClientPids
methods.description: Finds client PIDs associated with a binder node handle for a given process and service process.
